panel.summary: MemNoteStore's undo/redo stacks grow without bound, one full text snapshot per edit
panel.evidence: `pushUndo` (memory.ts:97) appends a complete copy of the document text on every edit and the stacks are never trimmed, so N edits on an M-byte note retain O(N*M) bytes for the process lifetime — a client-side memory-exhaustion vector if MemNoteStore is ever mounted on user-supplied content. Today `grep MemNoteStore` finds only test files plus the `packages/notes/src/node.ts` export, so there is no production consumer; capping the stack (as CodeMirror's history does with minDepth) would remove the hazard before one appears.
